bindings.title: Повседневные взаимодействия / адаптация под каждую Live2D-модель

notes: Drawable names are informational. Native gd_cubism does not expose universal hide-drawable controls.
Numeric Part IDs have no verified garment mapping: no Part opacity is disabled automatically.
The clothes-free pose disables known parameter switches; verify against the rendered model.
Unity snapshot data is preserved for review and is not applied to physics-owned parameters.

import_note: Parameters and parts are extracted; application bindings require validation in your project.
